purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public land-record/map routes, bounded anonymous access review, and evidence limits.
assessment: The official Punjab PULSE public-user viewer currently loads a Gujranwala cadastral ArcGIS layer. A bounded envelope query near the WUP point returned three polygons; the exact WUP point query returned no features. Samples are retained with only native OBJECTID identities. The service disclaimer says the map is indicative and not a legal boundary.
registryAssessment: Municipal Committee Kamoke is evidenced as a local map custodian, while PLRA/PULSE is a provincial land-record/GIS custodian. No city-specific authoritative cadastral registry endpoint was established, so registryFound remains null.

queries.query: Kamoke Punjab Pakistan official cadastral parcel map land records PLRA
queries.outcome: Official PLRA, PULSE, Municipal Committee Kamoke, and Kamoke base-map references found; PULSE JS exposed the current cadastral service.

queries.outcome: Official Urdu-facing LRMIS/PLRA references found; no Urdu-specific Kamoke parcel API identified.

attempts.result: Downloaded current viewer HTML/JavaScript; public-user path and service configuration were inspected. Login is available for complete parcel details, but no login was used.
Anonymous viewer token endpoint returned an app-issued token used only in-memory for the public ArcGIS metadata/query requests; token value was not retained.
Direct metadata request without the viewer token returned ArcGIS Token Required; no bypass was attempted.

With the anonymous app-issued token, Gujranwala layer metadata returned polygon geometry, source WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857, OBJECTID object-ID field, and Khasra_ID among source fields. No owner/address fields were requested.

Bounded envelope [74.218,31.971,74.228,31.981] in EPSG:4326 with where=1=1, returnGeometry=true, outFields=OBJECTID,Khasra_ID, resultRecordCount=3, and outSR=4326 returned three polygon features; exceededTransferLimit was true. Retained samples use only OBJECTID identities.

Exact WUP point [31.976363675421,74.2232766931292] queried as an EPSG:4326 point with returnGeometry=true and safe fields only; response was an empty FeatureCollection. This is an exact-point miss, not citywide absence evidence.
Official PLRA landing page loaded; service context was recorded, but no city-specific parcel-vector endpoint was obtained from it.
Anonymous request timed out; no retry with credentials or unsafe fields.
Official Municipal Committee Kamoke maps index loaded and linked current municipal maps.
Official rendered Kamoke base map downloaded; parcel boundaries are shown in the legend, but no native vector IDs or full machine-readable polygons were extracted.

nativeFieldMapping.Khasra_ID: Observed in response but value 0 in all retained features and omitted from retained properties

geometryEvidence.crs: EPSG:4326 in retained GeoJSON, requested from source WKID 102100/3857

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Empty FeatureCollection for exact WUP point [31.976363675421,74.2232766931292]; point was preserved and not shifted.
geometryDecision.retentionNote: Exactly one canonical native identity is retained in each GeoJSON feature properties object; raw source attributes were not retained.

remainingUncertainty: The public layer is provincial and named Gujranwala rather than Kamoke; the bounded response does not prove complete Kamoke city coverage. The exact point was not contained in a returned feature. Khasra_ID was zero in the samples. PULSE disclaims legal boundary use, and the current viewer may require login for complete parcel details. No login, credentials, unsafe fields, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS verification bypass was used.
runtimeAssessment: held; serial reviewer must independently qualify any adapter
